title: Your semester, all in one place.
subtitle: Organize your courses, plan your deadlines and keep track of your grades. At your own pace, in your own way.
pageHint: Create a page for each semester, term or project. Each has its own courses and assessments.
confirmDeletePage: Delete this page and all its courses and assessments? This cannot be undone.
scaleHint: Match your institution: 0–20, 0–10, 0–100 or another numeric scale.
invalidScale: The maximum must exceed the minimum, and all existing grades must fit the range.
confirmDeleteCourse: Delete this course and all its assessments? This cannot be undone.
addDatesHint: Add dates to your assessments to see them here.
overdueCount: {count, plural, one {# overdue assessment} other {# overdue assessments}}
evaluationPlaceholder: e.g. Midterm exam or final project
localTimezone: Times use your device's time zone. Exporting preserves the exact instant.
invalidDates: Enter both dates. The deadline cannot be before the start.
confirmDeleteEvaluation: Delete this assessment and its grade?
dateRequired: Add dates to export to a calendar
noResults: No matching assessments. Try another filter or add a new one.
noEvaluations: Add your first assessment and assign its weight.
calendarHint: Select a day to schedule. Select an assessment to edit it. Bars span the full date range.
calendarOptional: Dates are optional. Calculate grades with or without a schedule.
completeGrades: All grades are entered and the weights add up to 100%.
partialHint: Provisional result: ungraded assessments do not contribute points yet. Complete all grades and 100% of the weights for the final grade.
formula: Each contribution is grade × weight ÷ 100. The result adds these contributions without institution-specific rounding.
confirmClear: Clear this course's grades? Assessments and dates will be kept.
autosaveOff: Autosave is off. Select Save to keep your changes before leaving.
leaveWarning: You have unsaved changes. Leave and lose them?
storageError: This browser could not save your data. Check storage space and permissions. Your changes are still open; select Save to try again.
corruptData: Saved data could not be read and has not been overwritten. Keep a copy of your browser storage before saving new data.
conflict: Another tab changed the saved data. Autosave has been paused to avoid replacing it. Reload to use that version or select Save to keep this tab's version.
emptyHint: Add your first course, choose its color and organize assignments, exams and grades in one space.
localPrivacy: Your data is saved only in this browser.
